note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997); the original is in English; alates and soldiers were examined from paratype specimens; the width/length index is recorded as 0.589–0.652 because of OCR damage in the measurements; distribution records, synonymic citations, type information and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier body length 5.5–8.5 mm; head capsule subrectangular, length with mandibles 3.9–4.4 mm, maximum width 1.33–1.50 mm, width/length index 0.589–0.652; frons inclined 45°; anterolateral angles produced into moderately large lateral tubercles; anterolateral angles of labrum prolonged into slender needle-like processes; gula with a long and narrow waist. Alate body length with wings 12.5–14.2 mm; head capsule broader than long including eyes; compound eyes round and prominent. Worker body length 3.60–5.50 mm; head subcircular; fontanelle plate oval to circular.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to yellowish brown; antennae yellowish brown to pale brown; labrum semitransparent, weakly sclerotized medially; left mandible nearly black, right mandible reddish brown; legs and body creamy white to pale yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 5.5–8.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight or slightly convergent anteriorly; anterolateral angles produced into moderately large lateral tubercles; length with mandibles 3.9–4.4 mm, length to mandibular base 2.08–2.45 mm, maximum width 1.33–1.50 mm, width/length index 0.589–0.652; coronal suture extending from the posterior margin to half the head length; frons inclined 45°. Fontanelle transverse, situated on the frontal slope about 4/5 of the head length from the posterior margin. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal, segment 3 sometimes longer than segment 2 or 4. Labrum asymmetrical, anterior margin deeply incurved; anterolateral angles prolonged into long needle-like processes, anterolateral margins with 1 or 2 tooth-like projections or serrations; length 0.40–0.60 mm, width 0.30–0.40 mm. Mandibles asymmetrical, only slightly shorter than the head; left mandible 1.85–2.20 mm long, right mandible 1.87–2.15 mm long, index (left mandible length/head length without mandibles) 0.844–0.933. Left mandible twisted medially, with a distinct beak apically. Right mandible blade-like, inner and outer margins weakly incurved, apex strongly incurved and with a long pointed tip. Gula rod-shaped; waist long and narrow, situated below the middle; length 1.0–1.2 mm, maximum width 0.33–0.43 mm, minimum width at the waist 0.18–0.22 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly notched; length 0.25–0.35 mm, width 0.75–0.88 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, antennae and postclypeus creamy white to pale yellow; legs and thorax slightly paler; abdomen transparent, gut contents visible through it. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.60–5.50 mm. Head capsule subcircular, length to tip of labrum 1.33–1.40 mm, length to mandibular base 0.85–0.93 mm, width 1.05–1.13 mm; fontanelle area slightly depressed. Fontanelle plate oval to circular, diameter 0.10–0.17 mm. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus convex and hairy, about half as long as wide or slightly more, length 0.26–0.28 mm, width 0.50–0.55 mm. Mandibles, pronotum, legs and abdomen as in the genus; pronotum length 0.25–0.30 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; postclypeus yellowish brown; antennae pale brown; pronotum brown; legs yellowish brown; wings pale brown; abdomen brown dorsally, slightly paler ventrally. Head and body densely covered with short microtrichia and a few long setae. Body length with wings 12.5–14.2 mm, without wings 5.6–8.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, broader than long including eyes; length to tip of labrum 1.35–1.57 mm, length to mandibular base 0.88–1.00 mm, maximum width 1.25–1.38 mm; Y-shaped suture absent. Fontanelle plate semitransparent, long and narrow, length 0.075–0.10 mm. Compound eyes circular, distinctly prominent, equidistant from the lower margin of the head and from the antennal sockets, maximum diameter 0.30–0.33 mm. Ocelli broadly oval, long diameter 0.13–0.18 mm, short diameter 0.10–0.15 mm, separated from the compound eye by half to about one long diameter, minimum distance between eye and ocellus 0.08–0.13 mm. Antennae 14–15-segmented; segment 3 short; in 14-segmented antennae segments 4 and 5 subequal, in 15-segmented antennae segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 4. Postclypeus convex and hairy, about half as long as wide, length 0.25–0.30 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm; divided into two halves by a shallow line. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat, anterior margin slightly raised, narrower than the head; length 0.58–0.63 mm, maximum width 0.88–1.00 mm; anterior margin weakly incurved and with a median notch; posterior margin rounded and with a distinct notch. Wings pale brown, margins ciliate, membrane sparsely hairy; surface sculpture consisting of marginal papillae and micrasters on the membrane; fore wing length with wing scales 10.3–11.2 mm, hind wing length with wing scales 10.0–11.0 mm. Legs and abdomen as in the genus.
